ModMetaData.name: VPE - Spatialist
ModMetaData.author: darky
ModMetaData.description:
A Vanilla Psycasts Expanded path built around a personal pocket dimension, a small room of folded space. The caster opens a gate to it wherever they stand, and anyone can walk through, so it doubles as storage that travels with its maker.
Psycasts: - Pocket Gate: open a gate to your pocket a few steps away. Use it again to close it. The pocket and everything in it last as long as the caster lives. - Spatial Pockets (passive): +100 kg carrying capacity for inventory and caravans, and +75 kg per hauling trip. - Stash: skip an item stack into the pocket without opening the gate. Cast from inside the pocket, it skips items out next to the gate, which must be open. - Displace: Stash for every item in a 3x3 area. - Expand Pocket: grow the pocket from 15x15 to 25x25, 35x35 and finally 45x45. - Sanctuary: skip the caster into the pocket along with every colonist, colony animal, mechanoid, prisoner and guest within 5 cells. - Spatial Bag: make a backpack that adds 100 kg of carrying capacity at 100% psychic sensitivity, scaling with the caster's sensitivity. It costs 200 neural heat, so turn the heat limiter off to cast it.
Good to know: - Closing the gate skips anyone still inside out next to it. - If the caster dies, the pocket collapses and its contents spill out near the body. - The gate closes when a gravship takes off; the pocket itself is kept. - Find it on VPE's Arcanum tab.
